opus5_L1_r1.headline_model: Ridge regression on log load, calendar-only features, level correction, empirical 80% band
opus5_L1_r1.audit_note: Alpha and the level correction were selected on 449 rolling winter origins with every 1-8 January window excluded as an evaluation target, but the origins continue through February 2020 and each fit trains on all hours before its origin, so the January 2020 test week entered the training data behind the hyperparameter choice (independent reader, output/tune.py:21-22,56). The final comparison also scored six candidates on the 2020 week after an earlier alpha=3 forecast had been scored, so the chosen alpha=30 was the best of seven test-scored configurations. The CSV's timestamp_local column is naive Berlin time and timestamp_utc is provided; scored with the local-time override, which the agent documented. The reader found no forecast file because of the shifted window; the file exists and recomputes to the agent's number.
opus5_L1_r1.reason: final message reports MAPE 3.07% for the shipped ridge model and names forecast_2020_jan_w1.csv; recomputed 3.071 with Europe/Berlin for the naive local column
